findings.problem: The fresh-output preflight omits the resume stdout/stderr files (media-resume-hardware.*, media-resume-list.*, media-resume-run.*). Exclusive x-mode opens prevent overwriting, but if a stale stderr exists, the corresponding stdout may be created before opening stderr fails. This can leave a partial refusal after the owner record and may occur after earlier hardware/list commands have already run.
